description: This is a Java source file defining an abstract class 'AmqpCliClient' which provides functionality for connecting to an AMQP adapter, creating senders, and managing configuration properties related to AMQP connections. It is part of a CLI tool for interacting with Hono's AMQP adapter.

classes.name: AmqpCliClient
classes.description: An abstract base class providing methods to connect to and interact with an AMQP adapter, including creating senders and managing connection properties.

methods.name: setClientConfig
methods.description: Sets the client configuration properties for connecting to the AMQP adapter; can be optionally autowired.

methods.name: createSender
methods.description: Creates an anonymous sender link on the established connection to the AMQP adapter; throws if the connection is not yet established.

methods.name: connectToAdapter
methods.description: Establishes a connection to the AMQP adapter with optional SASL authentication and TLS settings.

methods.name: addTlsTrustOptions
methods.description: Configures TLS trust options for the client connection based on the provided configuration properties.
